evidence_paths.makefile: Makefile (setup, install, test, demo, preflight targets)

supported_commands.make_setup: make setup (venv + deps + Remotion npm + piper + HyperFrames cache)

pipeline_system.definition: Pipeline manifests in pipeline_defs/*.yaml define stages, tools, skills, and gates
pipeline_system.execution: Pipeline is executed by an AGENT (human or AI), not by a Python script. The agent reads director skills and drives tools.
pipeline_system.stages: research -> proposal -> script -> scene_plan -> assets -> edit -> compose -> publish
pipeline_system.checkpoints: lib/checkpoint.py: validate, read, write checkpoint state per stage

render_system.render_demo_py: ONLY for Remotion demos with JSON props in remotion-composer/public/demo-props/. NOT a general render entrypoint.
render_system.project_structure: Projects live under projects/<project_id>/, checkpoints under <project_id>/pipeline/

canonical_render_command: Agent-driven via tools. No single 'python render.py' command exists. The render_demo.py is Remotion-specific demo only.
blockers: render_demo.py is NOT a general render entrypoint - only renders Remotion JSON-prop demos
Full pipeline requires AI agent orchestration, not a single Python call
OpenMontage is an instruction-driven system: the AGENT reads skills and drives tools
No single 'render everything' CLI command exists
